propositions: The snapshot janitor runs only in the review-bot process, leaving every other host with an append-only snapshot store that accumulates entries without reclamation.

A host that resolves attested gates without running the review-bot server must trigger garbage collection via an operation-linked check on the tail of gate resolution, using a near-free in-process O(1) decision followed by detached child work off the critical path.

The trigger mechanism must avoid long-lock pitfalls by holding no ticket-store lock, performing no store enumeration, and never raising into the gate operation, with heavy work deferred to a detached child process.

Single-flight semantics across simultaneous hosts and worktrees must be enforced via stamped worker-lock sidecars keyed on the snapshot store root, with harmless degradation (skipped="locked") when overlap with run_gc occurs.

The review-bot's resident janitor remains untouched and supplementary; both trigger-spawned and resident passes use the same run_gc policy, so fresh passes reset the clock only when an actual pass completes (not on stand-aside).
